title: Cost-per-order drift +$0.62 — carrier GRI ingested
narrative: Routing and carrier rules apply at the 02:00 window and are reversible in minutes. Packaging and transfers are not — those commit money, so they run last.

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

verification.label: Optimal-node rate
verification.note: share shipped from the nearest covered node

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, a new rate card re-opens this card and waits for you.

plan.name: Routing rules · OMS and 3PL
plan.meta: rule set v14 · versioned to the Ledger · applies at the 02:00 window

items.name: Zone 7–8 origin selection
items.detail: Proximity becomes the first test for Zones 7 and 8, stock depth the tie-break. Falls back to East automatically when the West line is under cover, so the rule cannot strand an order.

items.name: Zone 5 tie-break
items.detail: Ties resolve on committed transit time rather than a one-cent postage difference. Affects about a quarter of Zone 5 volume.

items.name: Rate shopping with 1-day headroom
items.detail: Cheapest service whose committed transit clears the promise by a day. The Delivery Promise Model supplies the transit table, refreshed weekly.

items.name: Allocation targets by zone band
items.detail: Meridian holds Zones 6–8 and all expedited; Fairline takes Zones 3–5 ground; consolidators keep Zones 2–5 where their on-time is acceptable.

items.name: GRI rates loaded
items.detail: New base rates and residential surcharges written into the rate card so every quote from Oct 1 prices correctly rather than under-quoting and reconciling later.

items.name: Minimum-share monitor
items.detail: Daily check that Meridian volume stays above 55%. If a week trends under, allocation reverts to the v13 mix automatically rather than losing the tier discount.

plan.name: Packaging specs and POs
plan.meta: 6 SKUs right-sized · 2 box POs · glass and enamel unchanged

items.name: Pack spec update at the 3PL
items.detail: Care kit and filter 3-pack to B-06 and B-05; whetstone and paring knife to B-04; spatula pair and shears stay boxed pending the damage read.

items.name: Box purchase orders
items.detail: Two POs for B-04 and B-05 at 8-week cover. Existing B-12 stock runs down rather than being written off.

items.name: Damage baseline snapshot
items.detail: Current 2.1 claims per thousand recorded per SKU before the change, so any deterioration is attributable rather than argued about.

plan.name: Repositioning transfers
plan.meta: 4 SKUs to Reno · 21-day cover · $6.2K transfer cost

items.name: Transfer plan to West node
items.detail: Skillet 10", skillet 12", filter pitcher and chef knife move on the next two inbound consolidations rather than as an expedited transfer.

items.name: Reorder points recalculated
items.detail: West reorder points and safety stock updated for the new demand share so the node does not fall out of cover in week three and undo the routing rule.

items.name: Routing rule armed on arrival
items.detail: The Zone 7–8 rule stays inactive per SKU until that SKU is physically at cover in Reno. No rule fires against inventory that has not landed.
